requiredFindings.title: Item 12 still requires the full-size cost measurement
requiredFindings.failureScenario: Item 11 r6 replaces the full-size pin. A lawful generated store cannot reach a 40 MiB closure, and X4T-a pins the linear charge (one object and its stored bytes per distinct record; 56 MiB at the bounds against the 112 MiB ceiling), a measured native read within TRUST_VIEW_COST, and boundary tests of the closure check: 40 MiB plus a full chain admits, and just over 40 MiB with a small chain refuses. Item 12's budget case still requires the measured cost of a closure at its 40 MiB total with 32 events and a 16-link chain, at most TRUST_VIEW_COST. That is the measurement r6 withdraws, and item 13 says X4T-0 drives every item 12 case. The rest of that case stays: a 33-event descriptor refuses, a 17-link chain refuses, a closure over 40 MiB refuses, and the ceiling refusal stays on the budget row. Required: item 12's budget case states the three r6 pins in place of the full-size measurement.

scope: Law X4T r6, diffed against accepted r5. Item 11's three-part cost pin is coherent. RF-1: item 12's budget case still requires the withdrawn full-size measurement. No product cargo.
